heading: Automatic refresh and more local panes
summary: File lists update after transfers and backups, and the local file browser splits into up to six panes.
changes: Uploads, downloads, copies between servers, new folders, and backups show up without a manual refresh.
Split any local pane right or down, up to six panes. The layout is saved with workspaces.
Button tooltips that appeared in English are translated into Korean, Japanese, and Chinese.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
